summary: November 6, 2026 briefing compared with November 4. Pokémon Center's November 5 shipment-table update moves Delta Reign US/CA/UK estimates from early to mid-November; this is a shipment-estimate change, not a new purchase rule or drop. Walmart's six November 4 drawings are closed, results listed by November 7 at 6 p.m. EST. Five additional Target 30th Celebration mappings are verified on today's street date, all showing out of stock. No substantive newly introduced purchase-limit or checkout-rule change was established for October 30–November 6. Product access, signed-in stock and local allocation remain limited as detailed below.

retailers.coverage: Nine official product pages read: four Delta Reign and five 30th Celebration listings. Prices, identifiers and today's street dates verified; all show out of stock/final sale. Five 30th mappings are additions to November 4 coverage. No numeric cap, official opening hour or local allocation verified. Terms and preorder help rechecked; no signed-in checkout.

confirmed.title: Drawing and aggregated quantity baseline
confirmed.details: Account required; free entry once per drawing. Address, payment and quantity lock at entry, which cannot be canceled. Selection automatically places an order subject to processing; existing cart cannot combine. General caps may aggregate person, household, order, account, payment and address. Drawing orders below $35 may incur delivery fees; existing-cart items cannot be added to meet the threshold.
confirmed.planningImpact: Confirm details before entry; profile counts do not expand the permitted household allowance. Rules match prior coverage.
checks: Verify event-specific eligibility/cap and any Walmart+ requirement; no universal Walmart+ requirement verified.
